notes: Pages 6-27 (TM definition and theory) skimmed; Sec. 5 (pp. 27-35) and Sec. 6-7 read fully. Clause scope: the Multi-Class TM sums n/2 positive and n/2 negative clauses per class (Eq. 63), but the experiments print a single count ('300 clauses', '1000 clauses', '20 clauses') without scope; only MNIST says '40 000 clauses, 4000 clauses per class', so only MNIST is scoped (total). A&A: 10 000 clauses for predicting output bit 5 of 20; whether one TM per output bit was used is not stated, so scope not_reported. n_states is the paper's 'each Tsetlin Automaton has K states' (whether this is N or 2N in Fig. 1 terms is not stated). MNIST internal inconsistency: text says 40 000 clauses with T=50, while the Fig. 10 legend lists 40 000 clauses with Threshold=100 (and 20 000 with 50, 10 000 with 25); the text value is used. Hyper-parameters were tuned by 'relatively light grid searches' (Sec. 5, p. 28) on unspecified data; no validation set is described, so validation_used_for and baseline selection_on_test are not_reported. Binary Digits: the paper cites the UCI Pen-Based dataset (10 992 instances) but describes 64 pixel features, which matches the 8x8 optical digits; modality set to image following the paper's 'pixel' wording. Iris/Digits n_literals would be 2x the bit count but is not printed. Figures 7, 9 and 10 (s sweep, data-size sweep, MNIST curves for 10k/20k/40k clauses) are not in the record and values there are only visible in plots.
